Name: Sarah Beth Hinton
Author: deleted134305843
Description:
[center][font=Tahoma]CREDIT - These portraits are for the Ridgeside Village Mod Expansion made by Rafseazz. I got permission to post.

These are just some of my own edits to the villager portraits from Ridgeside Village. Some of them only have minor changes. I am still working on about half of the portraits, but I will update the mod as I go. I was just making this mod for myself, but I figured I would share them incase anyone else might want them.

So far I have only edited portraits for Alissa, Anton, Ariah, Belinda, Blair, Bliss, Bryle, Corine, Daia, Faye, Ian, Jeric, Lenny, Maddie, Malaya, Naomi, Olga, and Phillip.

I haven't been able to test all villager portraits, so please let me know if there are any issues with them (:
Also message if there are any suggestions or edits you think would be good for the portraits. Thanks so much! <3


[b][size=5]READ ME[/size][/b]
To install the mod, either use mod manager to install. Or you can manually download, then unzip the file and paste into your Mods folder. I have added Content Patcher version with a config file. You can use the Config Mod to turn on and off any villagers alternate portraits you do or don't want to use while in game. Or you can edit the config file and change any portraits you don't want to use to false. Please message and let me know if y'all have any issues with the mod. I haven't been able to test out all villager portraits but I tested most. I will be updating with the rest of the villagers portraits as I go. [/font][/center]
